decisions.reason: Keeping help text visible when a field is empty does not change the required editable-field mechanism or legacy-field handling.
Persistent help text for an empty field does not revoke or alter the separate requirement to clear placeholder text when the field is activated.
The source decision concerns field-help visibility and duplication, not template theme colors.
The source decision does not change graphic bullet appearance, sizing, alignment, or color.
Field-help behavior is independent of legacy-to-new template copy-paste stability.
The source decision does not address paragraph or manual line-break behavior.
Allowing duplicated field-help text does not change the required style-set source, coverage, or additions.
The source decision concerns interactive-field help text, not Tab-controlled list hierarchy.
The source decision has no necessary effect on table or column stability during pasted-content workflows.
The field-help decision does not alter the task-local assessment method, budget, coverage, or outputs.
The source decision does not change heading, title, typography, or style-spacing requirements.
